name: Honeydew
notes:
- **Extensions:** add-ons that ask for an always-running background page (like ClearURLs) install instead of failing.
- **All Tabs:** swiping a tab away only works from the middle of its card, so a swipe near its edge or title slides between Private, Tabs and Temporary instead of closing the tab by accident.
- **Swiping the address bar to change tabs** now moves the page with your finger, with the next tab coming in beside it, like Safari, and the address slides along with it; let go and it slides the rest of the way. Swipe on past your last tab to open a new one (not when that tab is already a new, empty one).
- **Tab switching** slides in from the side the tab sits on in your tab list, whichever way you switch (sidebar, keyboard, swipe).
- **The toolbar shrinks** after you scroll down a little, however slowly, and comes back when you scroll up, reach the top or the end of a page, or a new page starts loading, like Safari's.
- **Touch and hold Back** for a list of the pages behind this one.
- **The progress bar** starts a little way in the moment a page starts loading, and a new load starts from the left instead of sliding back.
- Small touches: the Private · Tabs · Temporary slider ticks as you slide it; a light tap when a swipe is about to open a new tab; the suggestions panel rises and fades instead of bouncing in from the bottom.
- **Installing:** renewing with install.sh clears Xcode's old signing first, so the new install lasts the full 7 days instead of sometimes stopping the next day.

beta.notes:
### Tabs
- **Reorder tabs like Safari:** touch and hold a tab and drag it; the others slide out of the way as you go.
- **Pin, Duplicate, Mute and Close Other Tabs** in a tab's touch-and-hold menu.
- **Inactive Tabs:** tabs you haven't looked at in two weeks fold into one section at the top of All Tabs.
- **Shake to undo** closing a tab.
- **Pinch in** on a page to open All Tabs.
- **Calmer animations, tuned to Safari's own:** the toolbar shrinks with your finger as you scroll, things settle without bouncing, a quick address-bar swipe carries its speed into the next tab, and the progress bar runs to the end before it fades.

### Browsing
- **Paste and Go:** touch and hold the address bar.
- **Search suggestions** as you type, and a separate **Private Search Engine** for private tabs.
- Links to Mail, Phone, Messages, FaceTime, Maps and the App Store open those apps.
- An error page with Try Again when a site can't be reached.
- **Link previews:** touch and hold a link to see the page.
- **Print**, a **Contents** menu in Reader, and read/unread in Reading List.

### Websites
- **User Agent switcher:** Website Settings › User Agent makes a site see Fruitfox as Firefox or Chrome.
- **Tidier menus:** page, link, image and Website Settings menus regrouped (nothing removed).

### Sync
- Firefox Sync uses Mozilla's components from Firefox 159 for iOS.
